{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
df = df.sort_values('patient_id').drop_duplicates('patient_id', keep='last')

# Verify the deduplication
print(f'Original rows: {len(df)}')
print(f'Deduplicated rows: {len(df)}')
print(f'Number of unique patient_ids: {df["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
baseline_invalid = df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999
print(f'Rows with biomarker_baseline = -999: {baseline_invalid.sum()}')

# Check severity distribution
print('\nSeverity distribution:')
print(df['severity'].value_counts())

# Confirm arm-severity association
print('\nArm-severity joint distribution:')
print(df[['arm', 'severity']].value_counts())

# Check if the treatment effect can be computed after stratification
print('\nResponse rate by arm and severity:')
response_by_arm_severity = df.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['responded'].agg(['mean', 'count']).reset_index()
print(response_by_arm_severity)"}
